learning_outcomes.text:
Acquire competencies for analysis and synthesis using examples (=
leading examples).
Apply learned content to other technical systems – even those not known from the lecture – by transferring the exemplarily learned principles of operation and basic functions to other contexts.
Synthesize suitable systems for given problem statements.

assessment_methods.method: Successful participation in workshops in Machine Design I
Successful completion of assignments in Machine Design II
Written examination for Machine Design I and II (90 min)
Successful participation in workshops in Machine Design III and IV
Written part of examination for Machine Design III and IV (60 min)
Constructive part of examination for Machine Design III and IV (180 min)

assessment_rules: For Machine Design I and II, a prerequisite is successful participation in workshops and successful completion of assignments. The final assessment is a 90-minute written exam. For Machine Design III and IV, a prerequisite is successful participation in workshops. The final assessment consists of a 60-minute written part and a 180-minute constructive part.
